description: Fix bird physics so tapping doesn't send the bird flying off the top of the screen

userStories.title: Set explicit bird mass and tune impulse for controllable flight
userStories.description: The bird flies off the top of the screen on every tap because the impulse-to-mass ratio is wrong. SpriteKit calculates mass from density × area, making the circle of radius 18 have mass ~1018. The impulse value needs to match. Fix by explicitly setting bird mass to 1.0 and using a small impulse value (typical Flappy Bird SpriteKit games use impulse 4-8 with mass ~1.0).
acceptanceCriteria: Bird physics body mass is explicitly set to 1.0 (birdBody.mass = 1.0)
Ghost bird physics body mass also set to 1.0
Gravity adjusted to work with mass 1.0 (try -5 to -8)
flapImpulse adjusted to work with mass 1.0 (try 3 to 6)
A single tap should lift the bird about 60-80 points, NOT send it off screen
Bird should feel responsive: quick upward motion on tap, decisive fall between taps
The bird should be playable — able to navigate through pipe gaps (170pt) with timed taps
maxFallSpeed clamping still works (adjust if needed for new mass)
Build succeeds and test by running in simulator to verify bird stays on screen
userStories.notes: GameScene.swift line 240: after creating birdBody, set birdBody.mass = 1.0. Same for ghost at line 268. Adjust gravity (line 6) and flapImpulse (line 7). TEST IN SIMULATOR: run the app, tap multiple times rapidly, bird should bounce up and down within the screen bounds (390x520), never flying off the top (y > 580). Start with gravity=-6, impulse=4.5, mass=1.0 and adjust from there.

userStories.title: Add upward velocity clamping
userStories.description: Even with correct impulse, rapid tapping could accumulate upward velocity. Add a max upward speed cap to prevent the bird from ever flying off the top of the screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Add maxRiseSpeed constant (e.g. 300-400 pts/s)
In update(), clamp bird's upward velocity: if vy > maxRiseSpeed, set vy = maxRiseSpeed
Rapid tapping (spam tapping) should NOT send the bird off screen
Bird can still reach the top area of the screen but velocity is capped
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: In update() near the existing maxFallSpeed clamp. Add: if let vy = bird.physicsBody?.velocity.dy, vy > maxRiseSpeed { bird.physicsBody?.velocity.dy = maxRiseSpeed }

userStories.title: Verify and fix ghost bird physics to match player bird
userStories.description: Ghost bird must use the same mass, gravity, and impulse as the player bird so replays are accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Ghost bird has same mass as player bird (1.0)
Ghost bird impulse uses same flapImpulse value
Ghost replay visually matches what the original player did
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Ghost bird physics body is created around line 268. Ensure ghostBody.mass = 1.0 matches birdBody.mass.

userStories.title: Final play-test tuning pass in simulator
userStories.description: Run the game in the iOS simulator and verify the complete gameplay loop works: hover → first tap starts gravity → tap to flap through pipes → score → die → restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Bird hovers on launch (isDynamic=false)
First tap starts gravity (bird falls), no flap impulse applied
Subsequent taps give controlled upward boost
Bird can navigate through 170pt pipe gaps with timed taps
Bird never flies off top of screen even with rapid tapping
Bird falls and hits ground if not tapping (death triggers correctly)
Score increments when passing pipes
Death screen appears with correct messaging
Restart works after cooldown
Near-miss effects trigger when close to pipes
If any of the above fail, fix the issue before marking as complete
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Run: xcodebuild -project FlapFight.xcodeproj -scheme FlapFight -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' build && open -a Simulator. Play several rounds and verify all criteria.
